latin: Transcorporationem animarum crediderunt omnes sapientes Indorum, Persarum, Aegyptiorum, et Chaldeorum.
translation: All the wise men of the Indians, Persians, Egyptians, and Chaldeans believed in the transmigration of souls into bodies.
